# Ayush Misra

> Personal portfolio of Ayush Misra, a founder, developer and product builder based in Pratapgarh, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## About
Ayush Misra is the Founder & Director of Kartsho Solutions Private Limited. His interests and work include website development, mobile applications, digital products, product planning, business operations and community initiatives.

## Selected Projects

- LawDalat: Legal services platform project with client, advocate and administration workflows.
